title: Muffy subagent prompt envelope
description: Parsed form of the prompt template in references/token-discipline.md. Used by evals and mock scenarios to check Orchestrator prompts are lean and complete.

done_when.description: The observable result that ends the step; part of the prompt template in token-discipline.md

worktree.description: frontend-dev, backend-dev, qa-tester, devops mode 2: worktree path the Orchestrator created

branch.description: Branch checked out in that worktree

profile.description: fix: fix.md replaces ac/contract/brief/design in Read. lite: ac.md (Orchestrator-written) and contract.md, no brief.md or design.md

announcement.description: docs-writer only: the user opted in to a release announcement at pause:scope

pr_diagram.description: frontend-dev/backend-dev only: the user asked for the step-5b PR diagram

human_approved.description: devops step 11 only: date of the step-10 Human gate approval

full_regression.description: qa-tester only: the user approved a whole-system regression at pause:full-regression; absent = scoped tests only

checkpoint.description: Path of .team/<task>/checkpoint.md; required from round 2 or after a context summary

commit_trailer.description: Commit trailer line every agent appends to its commits; optional so older envelopes stay valid
